an7.7:1.1: VII. Atha kho Uggo rājamahāmatto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Uggo rājamahāmatto Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an7.7:2.1: ‘acchariyaṃ bhante abbhutaṃ bhante, yāva aḍḍho 'vāyaṃ bhante Migāro Rohaṇeyyo yāva mahaddhano yāva mahābhogo' ti. ‘Kīva aḍḍho pan' Ugga Migāro Rohaṇeyyo kīva mahaddhano kīva mahābhogo' ti? ‘Sataṃ bhante satasahassānaṃ hiraññassa, ko pana vādo rūpiyassā' ti. ‘Atthi kho etaṃ Ugga dhanaṃ? N' etaṃ natthī ti vadāmi, tañ ca kho etaṃ Ugga dhanaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ agginā udakena rājūhi corehi appiyehi dāyādehi. Satta kho imāni Ugga dhanāni asādhāraṇāni agginā udakena rājūhi corehi appiyehi dāyādehi. Katamāni satta? Saddhādhanaṃ, sīladhanaṃ, hiridhanaṃ, ottappadhanaṃ, sutadhanaṃ, cāgadhanaṃ, paññādhanaṃ. Imāni kho Ugga satta dhanāni asādhāraṇāni agginā udakena rājūhi corehi appiyehi dāyādehī' ti.
an7.7:3.1: Saddhādhanam sīladhanaṃ hiri ottappiyaṃ dhanaṃ sutadhanañ ca cāgo ca paññā ve sattamaṃ dhanaṃ.
an7.7:4.1: Yassa ete dhanā atthi itthiyā purisassa vā, sa ve mahaddhano loke ajeyyo devamānuse.
an7.7:5.1: Tasmā saddhañ ca sīlañ ca pasādaṃ dhammadassanaṃ anuyuñjetha medhāvī saraṃ buddhānasāsanan ti.
